test_title: PYST 5: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

All Birds are Sparrows.

All Sparrows are Reptiles. 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Reptiles are Birds.

II. All Reptiles are Sparrows.

III. All Birds are Reptiles.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I, nor II, and III follow.
Both conclusions I and III follow.
Both conclusions II and III follow.

solution: Statements: All Birds are Sparrows. All Sparrows are Reptiles. The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f01a750862d01f4c474c8197965999d534b3b556eeeca9fcea1df17773f6fd7.png]
